text: Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment itself, as part of its argument, references a specific named external program (e.g., named policy, initiative, scheme, service, organized program) or a specific named location (e.g., named country, city, region, place); generic/unnamed references ("some programs", "a country", "a city") don't count. The reference need not be endorsed or verified; list order is irrelevant. Ignore text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is eligible only if it otherwise qualifies. Output 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment qualifies; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
